notes.title: Mislight Update 2.0 Release + 40% Discount on Winter Sale
notes.notes:
It's been 6 months since we launched our indie game Mislight ✨
To celebrate, we are releasing version 2.0 just in time for the Steam Winter Sale with a 40% discount!❄️

We've been working on this big update for the past month thanks to a lot of feedback we got from the community and it addresses stuff like:

- Fixing and reworking wonky level design
- Attack balancing
- Enemy balancing
- Tileset & background redesign
- Music reworking and mastering
- Various bug fixes

We hope that the overall experience for current players is greatly improved with this patch⚙️

And if you haven't checked Mislight out yet, go grab it while it's 40% OFF during the Winter Sale! 💸
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208220/Mislight/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208220/Mislight/[/url]

notes.title: Update Note 1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We just released a patch fixing some minor bugs that have been appearing the last week, first we are sorry for the inconvenience and we have already fixed these bugs.

The bugs we fixed are:

- Fixed a bug that didn't let the player buy costumes in the Shop.
- Fixed a bug that didn't let the game recognize the controller.

We thank you all that have been reporting bugs within the game, as this allow us to keep patching and fixing minor problems.

Thank you all and we hope you enjoy the game! 💖

notes.title: Dev tries to speedrun Mislight while doing an AMA
notes.notes:
We will be showcasing our bullet-hell platformer game Mislight for the first time on stream!

Join us while we play the Demo as fast as we can and answer any questions related to the game and its development. If you like platformers, bullet hells or metroidvania-style games, this might be perfect for you!

Mislight is a Side Scroller Adventure game with a slight touch of Thriller.
Use the powers of your flashlight to light up the shadow creatures that roam through the forest and find your way out.

Check out the demo right now on Steam!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208220/Mislight/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208220/Mislight/
[/url]

You can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/EtherlightMx]Twitter[/url] for more updates or join our [url=https://discord.gg/jdvMCkDQYf]Discord[/url] community and stay in touch more closely to the development!

notes.title: Mislight Demo now available for Download
notes.notes:
We've been working very hard these past month to finally bring you the Demo for Mislight!

It entirely covers the first 2 areas of the game so it's a pretty big chunk of it.

Mislught is a Side Scroller Adventure game with a little bit of a spooky eviorment. It was inspired mostly on Cave story and Megaman games but we also wanted to add a little challengem, so,  after checking out tohou Luna Nights we decided to add a bullethell-like experience.

[list]
[*] Use a flashlight as your main weapon of defeating the shadow creatures.
[*] Shoot, dodge or parry the bullet hell-like attacks of all your enemies to survive.
[*] Gain Light Drops by defeating enemies to become stronger or use them to buy items, upgrades and costumes.
[*] Find the secret pages hidden throught the forest to learn more about events that transpired before your arrival.
[*] Unlock new powers and use them to clear puzzles blocking your path.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the demo and if you do, please follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/etherlightstudios]social media[/url],

We are also releasing the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/etherlight/mislight-an-adventure-game-with-a-small-touch-of-thriller]Kickstarter[/url] campaign on November 18 so consider supporting us over there. <3

That's it for now, hope you have fun and we'll see you on the next anouncement!

[i]-WalGallen from Etherlight[/i]
